newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX'S VAN GAAL IN ADVANCED TALKS WITH CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX'S VAN GAAL IN ADVANCED TALKS WITH CLUB.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam coach Louis van Gaal said his negotiations to sign for a foreign club were "at an advanced stage" but he still felt it too early to name his new employer, agency ANP reported on Tuesday.
"We are still talking over the details and I am confident everything will be all right," Van Gaal said.
He added that the final announcement would probably not come from him. "That I leave to the club," he said.
Van Gaal said he had made the statement to end speculation over where he was going.

"I have been linked to AC Milan, Barcelona, Newcastle United, Bayern Munich, you name it. I have to admit that list flatters me," he said, without making clear whether his new club was included in it.

The 45-year-old coach joined Ajax in 1988 and since then has won the club the Dutch league title for the last three seasons, the European Cup in 1995 and the UEFA cup in 1992. Ajax have also won the European Super Cup and been world club champions.
In October last year Van Gaal indicated he would leave Ajax at the end of this season to "spread his wings".
